name: Narboneta (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Narboneta (a castle and a tree on red above waves, with a scroll).
history: Municipal flag of Narboneta; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Narboneta arms — castle and tree above waves, with scroll
